heading: Production Chronology
intro: Six-year engineering progression at Wallstreet Algo Trading, from data verification pipelines to full multi-asset trading engine rewrites.

roles.title: Quantitative Developer
roles.contribution: Led the architectural rewrite of the firm’s core trading stack to support multi-asset expansion into Indian, Crypto, and FX markets. Engineered memory-mapped file buffers and blittable structs in C# and unmanaged C++, reducing memory usage by ~80%. Integrated SignalR streaming for real-time dashboard data broadcast.

roles.title: Stock Market Analyst for Strategies
roles.contribution: Developed automated time-feature extraction and pivot modeling pipelines comparing symbols against benchmark indices to support quantitative strategy research and pattern detection.

roles.title: Cloud Architect Engineer
roles.contribution: Designed and deployed a dynamic migration system for cloud-based trading execution, reducing operational infrastructure costs by 98.8% while improving support efficiency and deployment reliability.

roles.title: Market Data Streamer
roles.contribution: Engineered low-level socket streaming infrastructure delivering real-time stock market tick and quote feeds to hundreds of client endpoints with verified <10ms delay.

roles.title: Software Engineer & Developer
roles.contribution: Constructed automated pipelines to download, verify, clean, and validate historical datasets (tick, quotes, fundamentals, EOD, minute, ETF) and developed Python/C# market scanners with complex multi-condition filters for NYSE equities.

roles.title: Engineering Intern
roles.contribution: Assisted in the development, profiling, and debugging of in-house quantitative trading tools and data parsing utilities in C# and Python.
